description: How far the head of a section stands from its body. The question is the adopter's, because the distance depends on what the body holds, and a body that carries its own top edge wants none. The options are the page rhythm scale itself. arena-rhythm-group reads as one unit, arena-rhythm-component, the default, as a head over its own content, arena-rhythm-section as a head over a region of the page, and arena-rhythm-none closes the distance. Set --arena-rhythm on a container for a distance no step names. Write a length, or a derivation of tokens such as calc(var(--rhythm-group) * 1.5). A class on the section wins over a property on its container.
